_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 3% base rate over 7 days confirms a compressed coil where HOLD is the statistically honest default — no ETF flow resumption, no stablecoin acceleration, and no MVRV compression to true capitulation levels means the breaker to a directional move is not yet visible.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction and names Disbelief as the predicted phase; narrative writer does not issue a formal forward call but the bottoming analog implies directional upside, creating an implicit disagreement on direction
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 and stablecoin growth turns positive with BTC funding staying below 55
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC funding spikes above 65 with BTC dominance fade accelerating above 60 while VIX breaks 70
